task: Staged blobs larger than Node's default one-mebibyte execFileSync buffer cannot be read by the metadata commit path, so validation evidence can never be persisted and no story can enter TEST.
outcome: A story whose test-evidence.json exceeds one mebibyte persists its validation evidence and enters TEST; an unreadable blob reports its real error rather than presenting as a digest difference; a committed regression covers the above-limit case; aggregate artifact growth has a shipped or explicitly recorded disposition; and validate prints an advisory as the artifact nears the ceiling.
facts: isolatedBlobHash, isolatedGit and treeBlobHash in core/done-prepare-generated-metadata.ts call execFileSync with no maxBuffer, so Node's 1048576-byte default applies
The two hash helpers swallow the resulting ENOBUFS with a bare catch that returns null
The caller compares that null against the expected digest and reports verified metadata changed after manifest verification, which names concurrent modification rather than a buffer limit
Reproduced outside the repository: a 1400000-byte staged file throws ENOBUFS under default options and returns all 1400000 bytes with maxBuffer raised
Per-command captured output is already bounded upstream by trimOutput and MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS of twelve thousand characters in core/validation-executor.ts
handlers/verifier.ts serialises every command result into test-evidence.json, so the artifact grows with the NUMBER of configured commands, measured at 1369692 bytes on story B-9ff1
lattice.config.json validate.commands grew from 56 to 100 entries on 2026-08-14

buildLedgerSizing in core/proofstory.ts already implements a three-tier capacity classification consumed as warn before hard fail, and is read here as precedent for the advisory shape rather than modified
constraints: Fail-closed posture must be preserved: an unreadable blob must never be treated as a match
The commit path must keep distinguishing blob genuinely absent from blob could not be read
The hard-coded fifteen-minute watchdog ceiling is a separate defect and stays untouched
Which entries lattice.config.json declares is out of scope; only the new smoke registration is added
unknowns: Whether the aggregate artifact is bounded in this story or handed to a named successor change - CHK-004 requires the decision to be made and shipped either way
What warning fraction of the ceiling CHK-001 sets the advisory should use, measured against that ceiling rather than any external default
